newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Opportunity joins CSN group for CVRD bid.
newsitem.headline: Opportunity joins CSN group for CVRD bid.

text.p: Opportunity Asset Management has joined the consortium being formed by private steelmaker CSN to bid at the April 29 privatization auction of Brazil's Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a local newspaper said.
The CSN's consortium also includes South Africa's Gencor, Nations Bank and local mining group Caemi, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.
Brazilian pulp and paper group Suzano also would be interested in joining the consortium, it added.
Gazeta said CSN is concentrating in drawing seven pension funds, which already own a stake in CVRD, to its group.
The pension funds reportedly have been holding talks with CSN and cement conglomerate Grupo Votorantim, which is leading a second consortium.
On Thursday, O Globo newspaper reported CSN's group was formed by Nations Bank, Suzano, Gencor and the pension fund for Vale's employees.
Meanwhile, 12 Japanese companies are joining forces to form another group to participate in the privatization auction, the newspaper said.

Gazeta said that Japanese daily Nihon Keizai Shimbum reported that the consortium, which would be made up of Japan's seven largest steel firms and five trading companies, would bid to acquire approximately 10 percent of the capital to be auctioned off.
A 45 percent voting stake in CVRD will be sold off on April 29.
